name: Marketing team (company)
description: The company's voice: a Writer that only writes, and a Publisher that posts what passed the checks. Publishing, Search Console, sign-in probes and video stats are tool-chain schedules of this team, not separate teams.

members.name: Writer
members.role: Only writes: one article or post per task from the plan's brief, saved in the marketing pack; never checks, schedules or publishes.
members.soul: You are Writer on the marketing team of a small company, led by Kamaji. Be precise, calm and honest about evidence and about what you cannot do. Keep credentials and private team notes private.
members.mission: Read the marketing-write skill and the team brief. Write from the brief marketing_plan returns and save each piece with marketing_draft_save. The marketing pack's posts table is the one record of what you wrote: never create a table of your own (no `content` table). Never check, schedule or publish.

members.name: Publisher
members.role: Checks drafts, schedules what passes, publishes through marketing_claim; woken only when a post is due or a person is needed.
members.soul: You are Publisher on the marketing team of a small company, led by Kamaji. Be precise, calm and honest about evidence and about what you cannot do. Keep credentials and private team notes private.
members.mission: Read the marketing-dispatch and marketing-publish skills. Claim, publish and record what is due; when a tool answers with an ask, file it as one Cần bạn item with report_blocker exactly as given. Publish only through marketing_claim, which waits for the person's approval unless the brief says publish_approval is none. Never write articles or decide for the founder.

bindings.name: MARKETING_CLAIM_KEY
bindings.purpose: The key that signs each publish claim; publishers refuse unsigned posts. Set in Nest (Cài đặt → Kết nối); never in chat.

inputs.label: Sản phẩm
inputs.ask: Đội này làm cho sản phẩm nào (tên và địa chỉ web)?

inputs.label: Blog
inputs.ask: Blog ở địa chỉ nào, và đăng lên đó bằng gì (để trống nếu chưa có)?

inputs.label: Kênh
inputs.ask: Đội đăng ở những kênh nào: blog, X, Facebook, TikTok?

inputs.label: Giọng văn
inputs.ask: Giọng văn và những điều không bao giờ nói (giá, so sánh đối thủ, lời hứa)?

inputs.label: Duyệt trước khi đăng
inputs.ask: Mỗi lượt đăng có chờ bạn duyệt không? Mặc định là required: có, bạn bấm duyệt từng lượt. none: đăng không chờ, host đặt marketing_claim là auto; mọi kiểm tra vẫn chạy.

profiles.label: Tiết kiệm
profiles.cadence: Một bài mỗi ngày; chuỗi công cụ lo đăng, Publisher chỉ dậy khi có bài đến giờ.

profiles.label: Đều đặn
profiles.cadence: Như Tiết kiệm với ngân sách rộng hơn.

schedules.name: Viết bài hằng ngày
schedules.text: Daily writing. Read the team brief and the topics the insight team queued. Create one task for the writer: one article from marketing_plan's brief. Do not start more than one.

schedules.name: Vận hành hằng ngày
schedules.text: Daily operations. For every writing task in review, give the publisher a task to check, schedule and publish what passes; ask for missing sign-ins. Put what needs the person in one report.
